decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's goal of binding mobile communication, and PSD2 and pandemic-driven digitization keep results near aspiration, so there is no shortfall to trigger search, although its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.

Mobile PDF signing supports the strategic move toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain, even if its lack of visibility on the website suggests it may have been folded into the broader platform.
The multi-layer architecture mainly describes the integrated portfolio, so withdrawing it would free few resources and gain the firm little.

The shift to app-based authentication likely pushed the QR hardware token below aspiration, and with no website presence since 2018, problemistic search favors moving its resources to app-based identity development.

The payment compliance suite is peripheral to the core identity offer and has not been visible on the website, but regulated payment customers still value it and current slack allows the firm to carry it a while longer.
